rule.description: Registry persistence detected - Run key modification (T1547.001)

alert.full_log: reg.exe added HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\WinSvcHelper pointing to C:\Users\Public\update.exe, file hash matches known Cobalt Strike beacon loader per internal hash database

human_reasoning: Registry persistence pointing to a Public-writable directory, combined with a file hash independently attributed to a known offensive-security tool (Cobalt Strike) via both OTX and MISP. This is unambiguous - persistence + malicious hash attribution together leave no reasonable doubt.
